item.title: RTT: Rif. 6267_All. 3 - Development of high-resolution numerical techniques for applications in micrometeorology and dynamic downscaling (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-05 Astrofisica e cosmologia, fisica dello spazio, della terra e del clima

Global climate models fail to capture local phenomena due to their coarse spatial resolution—resolution that is nonetheless essential for assessing micro-scale climate change impacts, such as urban heat islands and pollutant dispersion. The research project aims to develop and optimize advanced numerical techniques for dynamic downscaling by integrating fluid dynamics data (LES/DNS) with mesoscale models (WRF). Its novelty lies in the use of advection schemes coupled with machine learning algorithms to reduce computational costs and overcome the limitations of traditional statistical methods by explicitly resolving turbulence. item.title: RTT: Ref. 6286_All. 3 - High Energy Physics with the ATLAS experiment at the Large Hadron Collider (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-01 Fisica sperimentale delle interazioni fondamentali e applicazioni

The research project includes participation in experimental activities, data analysis and software development at the ATLAS experiment of the LHC at CERN. The project includes involvement in working groups, with reference to analysis and advanced computing techniques also based on deep learning. Furthermore, technical activities related to the detector are also foreseen, including the subsystems designed for the phase 2 upgrade
